body: Over the last few days, I’ve been busy morning until night at the Emergence Christianity event in Memphis. You can follow it at #EC13 on Twitter. I had to leave Memphis early (festivities continue there today) and will spend today with Lutheran friends in Virginia. Much to post about next week, after I catch my breath.
